info.title: API.SH: OpenReview
info.description: The OpenReview API from API.SH: public OpenReview data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A researcher's public OpenReview profile by profile id (e.g. `~Yoshua_Bengio1`, as in openreview.net/profile?id=...): names, career history (position, institution, department, country, years), relations (advisors, advisees, collaborators) with their profile ids, expertise keywords, links (homepage, Google Scholar, DBLP, ORCID, Semantic Scholar, GitHub and more), institution email domains, gender and pronouns when the profile shows them, and `raw` with every other public profile field. Email addresses are never returned (the site masks them).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/openreview-profile

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Profile id or profile URL, e.g. `~Yoshua_Bengio1`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A paper's whole public discussion: official reviews with every score the venue asks for (rating, confidence, soundness, presentation, contribution) and their text, meta-reviews, the decision, author rebuttals and official and public comments, oldest first, each with its type and the anonymised role that signed it. Also the decision, the review count, each rating and their average. Filter by `type` (comma-separated).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/openreview-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Paper (forum) id or forum URL, e.g. `P42DbV2nuV`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only these reply types, comma-separated, e.g. `official_review,meta_review,decision` (also `official_comment`, `public_comment`, `rebuttal`; names follow the venue).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Full-text search over OpenReview papers and, with `source=reply` or `all`, their reviews and comments. Papers come with title, authors, profile ids, abstract, keywords, venue, PDF link, BibTeX and license; reviews and comments with their type, scores, text and the paper they belong to. Up to the first 10,000 matches; pass `next_offset` back as `offset` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/openreview-search

parameters.name: venue
parameters.description: Only notes of this venue (venue id), e.g. `ICLR.cc/2025/Conference`.

parameters.name: venue_id
parameters.description: Only papers whose final venue id is this, e.g. `ICLR.cc/2025/Conference` for accepted ICLR 2025 papers.

parameters.name: venue_name
parameters.description: Only papers with this venue label, e.g. `ICLR 2025 Poster`, `NeurIPS 2024 oral`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The venue directory: the venues currently active on OpenReview (`list=active`, default), every organiser on the site (`list=all`, e.g. `ICLR.cc`, `NeurIPS.cc`), or the sub-groups of one organiser or year (`parent=ICLR.cc` lists each ICLR year). Optional `query` filters the list by text. With `parent`, pass `next_offset` back as `offset` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/openreview-venues

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keep only venue ids containing this text, e.g. `2025`.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: List the sub-groups of this group instead, e.g. `ICLR.cc` or `NeurIPS.cc/2024`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
